msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia inarkadia-37.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing an oversized fluffy mohair jacket in a blurred check of purple, blue, brown and cream, over a light blue cardigan with dark jeans from the reference, walking at a street in the Casco Viejo of Bilbao, Basque Country, Spain, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia inarkadia-09.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a brown suede aviator jacket with a cream shearling lining and collar, with dark jeans from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia inarkadia-21.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a brown faux-suede jacket trimmed with long fluffy faux fur on the collar, cuffs and pockets, with black trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia inarkadia-12.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a light grey knit sweater with a black kitten print on the front, with black wide trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia inarkadia-30.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a red boiled-wool double-breasted short coat, with jeans from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
